SMTO-CFG-0084 — SMTO asked to add a Skill that isn't installed

GUID: 14837d75-1128-5deb-af40-bf03e38a11c6
Slug: capability-activation-unknown-skill
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_activation

What happened

  • SMTO's Agent asked to turn on a Skill by a name this SMTO doesn't have. Nothing was turned on, and SMTO won't guess a similar Skill instead.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the Task. If it keeps working after a Capability request blocked note, you don't need to do anything. SMTO tells the Agent the name wasn't found, so it can choose an installed Skill.
  2. If you expected a user Skill, open User Skills and check it is listed under Installed skills and shows Ready to select. A Skill that is removed, disabled or never installed can't be turned on.
  3. Open Capabilities by the message box, select Refresh catalog, set the Skill you need to Always, then start a new request. The Agent then has that Skill from the start instead of guessing its name.

What success looks like

  • The Task uses the Skill you expected, without a Capability request blocked note.

If it still fails

  • Send Copy error details to the person who manages SMTO; they show the Skill name that was asked for. Don't create or rename a Skill just to match that name.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Activation classification found no Skill with the exact requested ID in the current registry (capability_activation.unknown_skill); nothing was activated.

What this means

  • Activation classification cannot find the exact requested Skill ID in the current registry. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • Activation classification cannot find the exact requested Skill ID in the current registry.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the literal ID with the accepted manifest and installed registry, without guessing from a display name.

How to fix it

  • Compare the literal Skill ID with the run's accepted capability manifest and registry.skill_summaries() (classify in src/agent_runtime/native/capability_activation.py) without mapping from display names. Install or re-enable the intended Skill on /skills, then start a new run so its manifest includes it.
  • This Skill ID is not registered. Use an exact ID from the capability manifest.

Retry and execution caution

  • The reported capability or interaction condition changes.

How to verify the fix

  • An exact registered and eligible Skill ID passes classification.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass frozen authority, operation permissions or credential requirements.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
